name: Horns of Frenzy
label: Quest
description: Horns of Frenzy: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The final lesson Orokk teaches you, friend. To the sacred anvil and forge you return! Bring for Orokk two solid iron mauls, two silvered bronze boots, and two silvered bronze gauntlets.
See the fear in their eyes as you approach!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Show the iron who is in charge, friend!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Astounding! You have learned the way of the Omosh, friend!
